mapper.update: /* com.portal.user.poll.qrm.QustnrRespondManageMapper.updateQustnrRespondManage */ UPDATE LETTNQUSTNRRESPONDINFO SET SEXDSTN_CODE = #{sexdstnCode}, OCCP_TY_CODE = #{occpTyCode}, RESPOND_NM = #{respondNm}, BRTHDY = #{brth}, AREA_NO = #{areaNo}, MIDDLE_TELNO = #{middleTelno}, END_TELNO = #{endTelno}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = sysdate(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} WHERE QUSTNR_RESPOND_ID = #{qestnrRespondId}
mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.poll.qrm.QustnrRespondManageMapper.selectQustnrRespondManageDetail */ SELECT ( SELECT QUSTNR_SJ FROM LETTNQESTNRINFO WHERE QESTNR_ID = A.QESTNR_ID ) AS QESTNR_SJ, A.QESTNR_ID, A.QUSTNR_RESPOND_ID AS qestnrRespondId, A.SEXDSTN_CODE, A.OCCP_TY_CODE, A.RESPOND_NM, A.BRTHDY, A.AREA_NO, A.MIDDLE_TELNO, A.END_TELNO, A.QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID AS qestnrTmplatId, DATE_FORMAT(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM LETTNQUSTNRRESPONDINFO A WHERE A.QUSTNR_RESPOND_ID = #{qestnrRespondId}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.poll.qrm.QustnrRespondManageMapper.insertQustnrRespondManage */ INSERT INTO LETTNQUSTNRRESPONDINFO ( QESTNR_ID, QUSTNR_RESPOND_ID, SEXDSTN_CODE, OCCP_TY_CODE, RESPOND_NM, BRTHDY, AREA_NO, MIDDLE_TELNO, END_TELNO, QUSTNR_TMPLAT_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{qestnrId}, #{qestnrRespondId}, #{sexdstnCode}, #{occpTyCode}, #{respondNm}, #{brth}, #{areaNo}, #{middleTelno}, #{endTelno}, #{qestnrTmplatId}, sysdate(), #{frstRegisterId}, sysdate(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
